items.title: Art Farmer — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I worked with Lionel after that... Later on, I played in segregated places with Lionel Hampton’s band... I got the gig, and it got me out of LA

ctx.x: No, no. Just another bandleader around Chicago. But he was there at such an interesting time, like he went to high school with Lionel Hampton. I asked him, “What kind of guy was Lionel Hampton?” ‘cause I worked with Lionel after that, and he said, “Oh, he was just as crazy then as he is now” [laughs].
[Laughs] So, you were learning music both taking lessons and hearing it in the church, what other music were you hearing growing up?
